answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded stake slashed on proven duplicate identity. Each agent locks a bond before its work counts, and answers are scored by verifiers from disjoint ridge groups. Fake identities cannot share one cheap bond: every puppet needs its own locked capital, and cross-checks link near-identical answers to one operator, burning all linked bonds. Since reward per identity sits below bond plus slash exposure, an attacker must hold at-risk capital proportional to faked seats. Fixed as a sonnet: no free seat, no anonymous weight. Clones in the river of submissions crumble.
